entities.title: zazzle invoker
entities.summary: The client half of zazzle/daemon: a tiny C program that hands its command line, standard streams and working directory to the zazzle daemon and exits with the daemon's status, or replaces itself with daemon or a standalone tool for the commands that run as their own process. Run as `zazz`, or under an installed zazz script's name, it sends zazz requests instead.
entities.purpose: Builds `zazzle` with make, without libc on Linux and with only what libSystem must provide on macOS, so that each zazzle command costs little more than starting a process. Holds the Makefile, the README (what it does, build and test), the source in src/, the tests in test/ and the latency benchmarks in bench/.
boundaries: The daemon, its commands and the wire protocol live in src/macos/daemon; the daemon must be built before the smoke test or the benchmarks can run.

`zazzle TOOL` runs each tool of src/macos (`daemon`, `shell-tools`, `fix-network`, `free-disk-space`, `git-tools`, `ai-agent-rules`, `csharp-indexer` and `cyberspace-generator`; `git` is short for git-tools) from the tools' folder: libexec/zazzle beside the launcher's bin/ in an install, else the launcher's own folder; this folder only execs them. `zazzle agent get-rules` goes to the daemon; `zazzle agent llm|prompt` and `zazzle ai-agent` exec `daemon llm`, which runs ai-agent (src/macos/ai-agent).
The release ships the same build twice, as zazzle and as zazz, and `zazz install` links script commands to it; what zazz requests do is daemon's (src/macos/daemon/src/zazz).
build/ is build output and is ignored by git.
